category_title: Highly resistant students with autism and severe communication impairment
minimal_context: Hannah and a tutor are in an individual work session looking at a book with lift and reveal flaps.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's sit down and look at this lift and reveal flap book together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the book and begins looking rapidly through it independently, appearing to be absorbed in it.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me help you turn the page and see what is under this flap.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the adult and pushes the adult's hand away from the book.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to read this together. Look at this page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves away, pushes the adult away, and goes back to spending time looking at the book independently to withdraw from the attempt to interact.)

STUDENT: (Moves away, pushes the adult away, and goes back to spending time looking at the book independently to withdraw from the attempt to interact.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: withdraw from adults’ attempts to interact with her by Spending time looking at a book independently, and appearing to be absorbed in it

behavior_patterns.condition: when the student withdrew from the adult-led activity
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: turning away, moving away, pushing an object, or the adult, away
